comment:
§4.3.4, p. 98, lines 394–395. [highlight] On the text: «financing».
in HF, we are not using this term "health financing claims"
Only countries with explicit health coverage schemes and separate purchaser would operate on the basis of claims, but they could also use budgets.
We need a more generic wording here to not be health insurance biased.
